name: duckling_crest_puff
rationale: Plan revision after attempt-0 rejection: bilateral source features must use Y>=0 only; the pair member at Y=-3.5 was illegal. Removed it — the host mirrors the remaining Y>=0 puff across Y=0, restoring the same three-puff silhouette. Center puff at [0,0,4.5] tilted back -15deg overlaps the 14x12x2.5 base positively; side puff at [ -1.5, 3.5, 5.5] with half-extents <=3 mm keeps lowest Z ~2.5mm>0 even with -25deg tilt, overlapping the base in XY. All geometry stays well inside the 80x80x35 mm zone; soft ellipsoids avoid sharp intimidating silhouettes per the friendly-duckling brief. Camera lens on the head front and all source geometry untouched; adhesive-pad attachment and walking/printability remain open.
